subject.title: Feature discussion: model-centric token / cost view across providers

question: Should CodexBar sponsor a provider-scoped model-summary MVP now, or commit to a cross-provider Models view with canonical identity, provenance, and aggregation policy?
rationale: The existing data supports a narrow presentation change, but cross-provider identity, mixed billing semantics, double-counting, UI placement, CLI behavior, and settings are product contracts rather than mechanical implementation details.

options.title: Stage Provider MVP
options.body: Add model summaries in a dedicated provider detail surface without cross-provider aliases or mixed-currency totals, then reassess broader aggregation using feedback.

options.title: Design Full Models View
options.body: Approve a cross-provider view only after defining canonical model IDs, source provenance, currency grouping, exclusions, and CLI/UI contracts.

options.title: Keep Existing Surface
options.body: Retain model breakdowns in provider cost-history details and avoid expanding CodexBar into cross-provider spend analytics.

recommendation.title: Stage Provider MVP
recommendation.body: Add model summaries in a dedicated provider detail surface without cross-provider aliases or mixed-currency totals, then reassess broader aggregation using feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has the strongest history across cost-history UI, release direction, and recent accounting policy decisions.
